# Deep Dive: Tariff-Resistant Investments

Report 155 | Published 2025-02-02 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-2-2/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/155.json)

Tariff defense through valuation and local revenues.

Tariff pass-through and volatility cautions were useful. The explicit eighteen-month bitcoin call was wrong at maturity. Adobe illustrates the gap between growing earnings and successful equity returns, while ITUB supported the dated Brazil rebound. El Salvador reserve purchases and Lightning deployment require more careful distinctions than headline wallet balances or announcements.

**Coverage:** All liquidity, tariff, bitcoin, El Salvador, stablecoin, Adobe, Brazil, Chevron and gold sections read. Quoted 2021 and 2023 ideas retain their original clocks; reported holdings are excluded unless accompanied by a thesis.

## Claims

### 155-C01

**Bills offset QT drainage.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | treasury-duration-liquidity |
| Source blocks | 10, 12 |
| Thesis family | treasury-duration-liquidity |

Money-fund substitution from RRP into bills can cushion reserve drainage. It is not an unconditional identity: purchases funded from bank deposits can instead reduce reserves.

**Direction:** Separable components differ.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Decompose bill buyers and changes in Fed liabilities.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [FOMC statement](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20251029a.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2025-10-29 | Verified in the audit

FOMC announced aggregate securities runoff would conclude December 1 2025.

- [Reserve management purchases](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_251210a) | Federal Reserve Bank of New York | 2025-12-10 | Verified in the audit

The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.
